description: Permanently delete one auto-buy rule by `id` (`MObjectId`). Side effect: stops all future executions matching that rule; the rule cannot be restored. Idempotent — deleting a non-existent or already-removed id returns success. Requires a signature session and `mcp-session-id`. Use `tronsave_get_user_auto_setting` to list current rules first; prefer disabling/updating instead when reversibility is desired.
name: tronsave_delete_auto_buy_setting

code.description: GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing.

message.description: Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure.

success.description: Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`.

title: Delete Auto Buy Setting
